name: All Races All Classes (ARAC)
description: Data-only module: every race can be every class (SQL + server DBC + client MPQ). No rebuild.

sql.note: applied by the app, NOT db-import; wow-manage.sh keeps a marker modules/mod-arac/.arac_sql_applied and only re-applies on request (after a DB wipe)

notes: Lives under modules/ and is detected like a C++ module, but the install flow skips the rebuild. Removing the clone does NOT revert the SQL/DBC/MPQ. wow-manage.sh 2780-2874.
Restart the worldserver after the DBC copy.
